description: This file contains functions and classes for optimizing PyTorch models using FX, including fusion, dropout removal, MKLDNN conversion, and inference optimization.

classes.name: MklSubgraph
classes.description: Represents a subgraph of a model for MKLDNN optimization, containing nodes, start nodes, and end nodes.

classes.name: UnionFind
classes.description: Disjoint set data structure used for grouping nodes during MKLDNN subgraph detection.

methods.name: _parent_name
methods.description: Splits a qualified name into parent path and last component.

methods.name: matches_module_pattern
methods.description: Checks if a node matches a specific pattern of modules.

methods.name: replace_node_module
methods.description: Replaces the module associated with a node.

methods.name: fuse
methods.description: Fuses convolution/BN and linear/BN layers for inference.

methods.name: remove_dropout
methods.description: Removes all dropout layers from a model.

methods.name: extract_subgraph
methods.description: Extracts a subgraph from a model based on specified nodes.

methods.name: modules_to_mkldnn
methods.description: Converts eligible modules in a graph to MKLDNN versions.

methods.name: reset_modules
methods.description: Restores modules to their original state after MKLDNN conversion.

methods.name: gen_mkl_autotuner
methods.description: Generates a heuristic to decide if a subgraph should run in MKLDNN.

methods.name: use_mkl_length
methods.description: Heuristic to determine MKLDNN suitability based on subgraph size.

methods.name: optimize_for_inference
methods.description: Performs multiple optimization passes to prepare a model for inference.
